violates: Compare running images, harness settings, prompts, MCP server lists, permissions, network policies, and self-hosted model weights against their approved baseline
Check that each one raises an alert and gets the documented response — block, quarantine, or rollback — within a set time

checks.note: The only comparison is the startup agent-type-id hash. It covers only prompts/*.txt, so prompts/system.md is excluded. It also covers neither the running MCP server list, nor k8s permissions or network policies, nor model weights (only model name strings). The image digest and git SHA come from env vars set by the same deployment, not from the live state.
The comparison runs once at process startup. There is no cron, scheduled job, admission webhook or change-event trigger for drift. The only CronJob is the reminders job.
A mismatch only logs and emits a metric. Startup then continues and the mismatched id is adopted. No block, quarantine or rollback is configured, and there is no time limit.

note: Drift detection is a startup-only type-id comparison that covers only part of the required inputs and, on mismatch, logs and keeps running with no response or time limit.
